---
title: "Exercises"
description: "Hands-on Git exercises for RStudio, Positron and the terminal."
---

Each exercise gives steps for **RStudio**, **Positron** and the **terminal**. Choose a tab once and every page remembers your choice.

| # | Exercise | When | What you'll learn |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | [Setup check](00-setup.qmd) | Before the session | Install, sign in, clone, render |
| 1 | [Your first pull request](01-first-pull-request.qmd) | In the session | Branch, commit, push, pull request |
| 2 | [Change a chart](02-change-a-chart.qmd) | In the session (stretch) | Editing code, CI checks |
| 3 | [Read a SQL diff](03-sql-diff.qmd) | Take-home | Diffs of queries and their output |
| 4 | [Oops, I committed data](04-committed-data.qmd) | Take-home | `.gitignore`, removing tracked files |
| 5 | [Undo a change safely](05-revert.qmd) | Take-home | `git revert` |

The [cheat sheet](cheatsheet.qmd) has every command on one page.

::: {.callout-important}
## Ground rules

- Never commit to `main`. Always work on a branch named `yourname/what-you-are-doing`.
- Never commit real data. Everything in this repository is synthetic, and it should stay that way.
:::
